name: Festival
announce: A festival has begun on the village green.

name: Market day
announce: It is market day: bread is half price at the shop, and goods fetch more.

name: Cold snap
announce: A bitter cold snap settles over the town. Keep the fires lit.

name: Service
announce: The chapel bell rings for the weekly service.

name: Royal jubilee
announce: Decree: the Crown celebrates a jubilee. Taxes are halved this quarter.

name: War levy
announce: Decree: the Crown levies the realm for war. Taxes are half as much again this quarter and bread costs more.

name: Fair prices
announce: Decree: the Crown fixes fair prices. Meals and bread are cheaper this quarter.
